blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Recent advances in text-to-image generation have substantially improved image quality, particularly through diffusion-based methods that require multiple inference steps. In contrast, Sphere Encoder offers an efficient generative framework capable of producing images with fewer forward steps. However, extending it to free-form text is nontrivial, because its class-conditioned design lacks cross-modal alignment. To address this challenge, we propose TextSphere, an efficient text-to-image generative framework that extends Sphere Encoder with language conditioning and cross-modal alignment. We incorporate pretrained CLIP text embeddings through adaptive layer normalization (AdaLN) to guide image generation while retaining the original spherical sampling mechanism. To bridge the cross-modal representation gap, we introduce a Spherical Semantic Alignment and Uniformity (SSAU) objective that jointly promotes semantic alignment and representation uniformity on the hypersphere. Experiments on CUB-200-2011, MS-COCO-2014, and Flickr30k demonstrate that TextSphere consistently reduces generation FID (gFID) over the text-conditioned baseline while achieving reconstruction FID (rFID) below 1.0. With only 4 and 6 sampling steps, TextSphere achieves lower gFID than the compared diffusion- and GAN-based models trained from scratch on CUB-200-2011 and MS-COCO-2014, respectively. We further observe that improved reconstruction fidelity does not necessarily yield better generation quality. In addition, we use Partial Least Squares Singular Value Decomposition (PLS-SVD) to analyze cross-modal alignment and modality gap, offering insight into the effectiveness of our approach.
blocks.zh: 最近在文字到图像生成方面的进展大大提高了图像质量,特别是通过传播方法,这些方法需要多个推论步骤。 相形之下, Sphere Encoder提供了一个高效的基因框架,能够以更少的前进步骤生成图像. 然而,将其扩展至自由式文本是非三角性的,因为它的类条件设计缺乏跨模式对接. 为了应对这一挑战,我们提议采用文本圈(TextSphere),这是一个高效的文本到图像分源框架,将Sphere Encoder扩展为语言条件和跨模式相接. 我们通过适应地层常态化(AdaLN)嵌入经过预先训练的CLIP文本来指导图像生成,同时保留了原始的球形采样机制. 为了弥合跨模式代表差距,我们提出了球形语义一致和统一的目标,共同促进超层语义一致和代表统一。 关于CUB-200-2011、MS-COCO-2014和Flickr30k的实验表明,TextSphere持续地将FID(gFID)的生成量降低于文本条件基准,同时实现重建FID(rFID)低于1.0. 由于只有4个和6个取样步骤,TextSphere的GFID低于分别从零开始在CUB-200-2011和MS-COCO-2014上培训的基于传播和GAN的模型。 我们进一步注意到,改善重建忠心不一定产生更好的发电质量。 此外,我们使用部分最不平面 Singular Value分解(PLS-SVD)来分析跨模式对接和模式差距,为我们的方法的有效性提供了深刻的见解.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Text-to-image (T2I) generation has made remarkable progress in recent years, enabling high-quality image synthesis from natural-language descriptions. Early approaches were primarily based on generative adversarial networks (GANs) [ 6 ] , while recent advances have shifted toward diffusion models [ 12 ] . These approaches, especially diffusion-based methods, have significantly improved image fidelity, semantic alignment, and high-resolution synthesis. However, generating high-quality images often requires multiple sampling steps, resulting in substantial computational overhead and inference latency. This motivates the development of efficient frameworks that can produce high-quality, text-aligned images in fewer steps.
For example, SANA-Sprint [ 4 ] combines continuous-time consistency and latent adversarial distillation for ultra-fast generation, reducing inference steps from 20 to 1-4. Trajectory Distribution Matching [ 25 ] and Score Identity Distillation [ 57 ] enable flexible few-step generation through distribution matching. More recently, 1.x-Distill [ 19 ] explores fractional-step generation to balance image quality, diversity, and efficiency. Despite these advances, such methods typically rely on pretrained diffusion or flow-based teacher models and additional distillation procedures, introducing training complexity and computational overhead. This motivates the development of efficient generative frameworks that eliminate the need for pretrained generative teachers.

blocks.en: Recently, Sphere Encoder [ 55 ] introduced an efficient generative framework for class-conditioned image generation, achieving competitive image quality with fewer than 5 sampling steps. It learns to map images into a uniform spherical latent space through spherical normalization and reconstructs them using a decoder, enabling image generation by directly decoding randomly sampled spherical latents. Inspired by this work, we study the potential of using Sphere Encoder for text-conditioned image generation by directly replacing its original class embeddings with contrastive language-image pretraining (CLIP) text embeddings extracted from the corresponding captions, while retaining the original adaptive layer normalization (AdaLN) conditioning mechanism [ 28 , 27 ] . To assess this adaptation, we employ Partial Least Squares Singular Value Decomposition (PLS-SVD) [ 60 ] to analyze the relationship between text and image representations. Our analysis in Section 6.2 reveals weak cross-modal covariance and directional correspondence, highlighting the limitations of direct text conditioning without explicit cross-modal alignment. We further investigate alternative conditioning mechanisms by comparing the cross-attention (CA) alignment approach [ 47 , 33 ] with the original AdaLN. Our preliminary experiments show that AdaLN consistently outperforms CA in generation quality within the Sphere Encoder framework, consistent with recent findings in [ 8 ] .
blocks.zh: 最近,Sphere Encoder [55] 引入了一个高效的基因框架,用于类条件图像生成,实现具有竞争力的图像质量,采样步骤少于5个. 它学习通过球体正常化将图像映射到一个统一的球体潜伏空间,并使用解码器重建图像,通过直接解码随机抽样的球体潜伏物来生成图像. 在这项工作的启发下,我们研究使用Sphere Encoder进行文本条件化图像生成的潜力,方法是直接用对比性语言-图像预训(CLIP)文本嵌入来取代其原始的类嵌入,同时保留原适应层正常化(AdaLN)调制机制[28,27]. 为了评估这一修改,我们采用了部分最小方块 Singular value 解析(PLS-SVD)[60]分析文本和图像表示之间的关系. 我们在第6.2节的分析显示,交叉模式的协同性和方向性通信薄弱,突出表明了没有明确跨模式对齐的直接文本调节的局限性。 我们进一步通过比较交叉注意(CA)对接办法[47,33]与最初的AdaLN,来调查其他的调节机制. 我们的初步实验表明,AdaLN在球形编码器框架内的生成质量上一贯优于CA,与[8]中的最新发现一致.

blocks.en:
Motivated by these observations, we propose TextSphere , an efficient text-to-image generative framework that extends Sphere Encoder with language conditioning and cross-modal alignment. Specifically, we incorporate pretrained CLIP text embeddings through AdaLN to guide image generation while retaining the original spherical sampling mechanism. To bridge the cross-modal representation gap, we introduce a Spherical Semantic Alignment and Uniformity (SSAU) objective that combines symmetric contrastive learning [ 29 ] and spherical uniformity regularization [ 49 ] , jointly promoting semantic alignment and representation uniformity on the hypersphere.
The contrastive component encourages matched text–image representations to be closer while separating unmatched pairs, whereas uniformity regularization promotes well-distributed representations within each modality. By aligning textual representations with spherical image latents, our framework enhances cross-modal semantic correspondence while preserving the structured spherical latent space for image generation. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to extend the Sphere Encoder framework to text-to-image synthesis. Our main contributions are summarized as follows:

TextSphere also achieves competitive or superior gFID compared with diffusion- and GAN-based methods trained from scratch using only a few sampling steps. blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Text-to-image generation has evolved from GANs to autoregressive and diffusion-based models. Early GAN-based approaches, such as AttnGAN [ 51 ] , DF-GAN [ 46 ] , and LAFITE [ 58 ] , explored text-guided image synthesis with efficient inference. Autoregressive models, including DALL-E [ 30 ] and Parti [ 54 ] , demonstrated strong generation capabilities through sequential token prediction. More recently, diffusion-based methods, such as LDM [ 33 ] and VQ-Diffusion [ 7 ] , have achieved high-quality generation but typically require multiple sampling steps. To improve efficiency, approaches such as LCM [ 24 ] , InstaFlow [ 23 ] , and DMD [ 3 ] enable few-step or single-step generation, often relying on pretrained models or distillation.
blocks.zh: 文本到图像生成已经从GANs发展到自动递归和传播的模型. 早期基于GAN的方法,如AttnGAN [51],DF-GAN [46],以及LAFITE [58],以高效推论探索了文本引导图像合成. 包括DALL-E [30]和Parti [54]在内的自动递归模型通过顺序符号预测表现出强大的生成能力. 最近,基于扩散的方法,如LDM[33]和VQ-Diffusion[7],实现了高质量的生成,但通常需要多个取样步骤. 为了提高效率,LCM [24],InstaFlow [23],和DMD [3]等方法可以少步或单步生成,往往依赖预先训练的模型或蒸馏.

blocks.en: Unlike these approaches, Sphere Encoder [ 55 ] enables efficient image generation by directly sampling from a spherical latent space, without diffusion-based denoising or teacher distillation. Building upon this framework, we introduce an efficient text-to-image generative framework that extends Sphere Encoder with language conditioning and cross-modal alignment, enabling high-quality image synthesis with few sampling steps. A more comprehensive review of related work is provided in the Supplement.
blocks.zh: 与这些方法不同的是,球形编码器[55]通过直接从球形潜伏空间取样,而无需基于扩散的去诺或教师的蒸馏,就能产生高效的图像. 在这个框架的基础上,我们引入了一个高效的文本到图像基因框架,将Sphere Encoder扩展为语言条件和跨模式对齐,从而能够以很少的取样步骤进行高质量的图像合成. 补编对相关工作进行了更全面的审查。

blocks.en: Fig. 2 illustrates an overview of our framework. Based on our preliminary findings that AdaLN outperforms cross-attention (CA) (Table 6 in the Supplement), we retain the original AdaLN conditioning mechanism to incorporate text embeddings into both the image encoder and decoder. The original Sphere Encoder employs reconstruction and consistency objectives, defined in Eq. ( 3 ), to preserve visual fidelity through pixel reconstruction, pixel consistency, and latent consistency. Motivated by the weak cross-modal correspondence revealed by our PLS-SVD analysis in Section 6.2 , we introduce the SSAU objective, which combines symmetric contrastive learning with spherical uniformity regularization to jointly enhance text-image semantic alignment and representation uniformity on the hypersphere.

blocks.en: We evaluate our framework on three established text-to-image benchmarks: CUB-200-2011 [ 48 ] , MS-COCO-2014 [ 21 ] , and Flickr30k [ 53 ] . Although larger datasets, such as CC3M/CC12M [ 39 , 2 ] and LAION [ 38 , 37 ] , are available, their storage requirements exceed our resources. The selected benchmarks nevertheless provide diverse evaluation settings, covering fine-grained objects, complex scenes, and varied text–image relationships.
blocks.zh: 我们根据三个既定的文本到图像基准评价我们的框架:CUB-200-2011 [48],MS-COCO-2014 [21],和Flickr30k [53]. 虽然有更大的数据集,如CC3M/CC12M[39,2]和LAION[38,37],但它们的存储需求超过了我们的资源. 然而,选定的基准提供了不同的评价环境,包括精细的物体、复杂的场景和不同的文本-图像关系。

blocks.en: CUB-200-2011 contains 11,788 images across 200 bird species, each with 10 captions, split into 8,855 training and 2,933 test images. MS-COCO-2014 contains approximately 82 ​ k 82k training and 40 ​ k 40k test images across 80 object categories, each with 5 captions, featuring complex multi-object scenes. Flickr30k comprises 31,783 images, each with 5 captions, of which 30,783 are used for training and 1,000 for testing, covering diverse everyday scenes.

blocks.en: We evaluate reconstruction performance using reconstruction FID (rFID) and Inception Score (rIS), and inference/generation performance using generation FID (gFID), generation IS (gIS), and CLIPScore. Fréchet Inception Distance (FID) [ 11 ] measures the distributional discrepancy between real and generated images, while Inception Score (IS) [ 36 ] assesses sample quality and diversity using a pretrained Inception network. CLIPScore [ 10 ] measures text–image semantic consistency through the cosine similarity of CLIP embeddings. We adopt gFID as the primary metric. Unlike gIS, which relies on classification-based predictions, gFID explicitly compares generated images against real data. Reconstruction metrics, in contrast, assess the model’s ability to recover existing images rather than its generative performance. Our experiments further reveal that improved reconstruction fidelity does not necessarily translate into better generation quality, as demonstrated in the ablation study in Section 6.3 . Moreover, CLIPScore provides only an approximate measure of text–image semantic alignment. Therefore, we report rFID, rIS, gIS, and CLIPScore as complementary metrics to provide a more comprehensive evaluation of reconstruction quality, generation performance, and semantic alignment.
blocks.zh: 我们利用重建FID(rFID)和Inception Score(rIS)来评价重建绩效,并利用生成FID(gFID),生成IS(gIS)和CLIPScore来评价推断/生成绩效. Fréchet Inception District(FID)[11]测量真实图像和生成图像之间的分布差异,Inception Score(IS)[36]利用预先训练的Inception网络评估样本质量和多样性. CLIPScore [10] 通过CLIP嵌入的余弦相似度测量文本-图像语义一致性. 我们采用GFID作为主要衡量标准。 与依赖分类预测的gIS不同,gFID明确将生成的图像与真实数据进行比较. 与此相反,重建指标评估该模型恢复现有图像的能力,而不是其遗传性能。 我们的实验进一步表明,改善重建忠贞并不一定会转化为更好的发电质量,第6.3节的废弃研究就表明了这一点。 此外,CLIPScore只提供了文本-图像语义对齐的大致尺度。 因此,我们报告RFID、rIS、gIS和CLIPScore是补充性衡量标准,以便对重建质量、生成性能和语义一致性进行更全面的评价。

blocks.en: We begin by evaluating the reconstruction capability of our framework across three datasets to assess its ability to preserve visual information in the spherical latent space. As reported in Table 1 , we evaluate 50K reconstructed images per dataset using reconstruction FID (rFID) and Inception Score (rIS). Our framework achieves rFID below 1.0 across all three datasets, indicating strong reconstruction fidelity. In terms of rIS, MS-COCO-2014 achieves the highest score of 36.25, followed by Flickr30k (24.17) and CUB-200-2011 (5.86). Qualitative results in Fig. 6 of the Supplement further demonstrate faithful reconstructions of fine-grained bird species in CUB-200-2011 and complex real-world scenes in MS-COCO-2014 and Flickr30k.

We evaluate the text-to-image generation performance of our framework across three datasets, investigating the effects of
classifier-free guidance (CFG) and iterative encoder–decoder refinement. Following the original Sphere Encoder, we employ CFG to control the strength of textual conditioning during inference. Using gFID as the primary evaluation criterion, we select the best-performing CFG scale for each dataset: 9.0 for CUB-200-2011, 2.0 for MS-COCO-2014, and 3.0 for Flickr30k.

Generation performance is evaluated using gFID, gIS, and CLIPScore, with detailed results presented in the right panel of Fig. 7 in the Supplement. Table 2 summarizes the best-performing configurations for each dataset in terms of gFID. blocks.en: 6.3 Reconstruction vs. Generation Performance
blocks.zh: 6.3 重建与生成性能

blocks.en:
Our ablation study in Supplement reveals a discrepancy between reconstruction
and generation performance. Specifically, removing the proposed
SSAU objective improves reconstruction fidelity, yielding a
lower rFID, but degrades generation quality, resulting in a
higher gFID. This suggests that improved reconstruction fidelity does not necessarily translate into better generation performance. While reconstruction primarily measures the ability to preserve visual information from existing images, generation additionally requires learning representations that support realistic text-conditioned sampling. These findings highlight the importance of explicit cross-modal regularization and further justify our use of gFID as the primary evaluation metric.

blocks.en: 6.4 Limitations
blocks.zh: 6.4 限制

blocks.en: Despite improvements in generation quality and cross-modal alignment, our framework has several limitations. First, generation performance remains sensitive to CFG scales and refinement steps, requiring dataset-specific configurations. Second, our experiments are limited to CUB-200-2011, MS-COCO-2014, and Flickr30k, without evaluation on larger-scale datasets, leaving the scalability and generalization of our approach to more diverse and complex data unexplored.
blocks.zh: 尽管在发电质量和跨模式协调方面有所改进,但我们的框架仍然有一些局限性。 首先,生成性能仍然对CFG尺度和完善步骤敏感,需要数据集特定配置. 其次,我们的实验仅限于CUB-200-2011,MS-COCO-2014,Flickr30k,没有评价更大规模数据集,使得我们对更多样化和复杂数据的方法的可扩展性和概括性没有得到探讨.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: In this work, we introduce TextSphere to extend the Sphere Encoder for efficient text-to-image generation and propose an SSAU objective to strengthen cross-modal correspondence in the spherical latent space. By combining symmetric contrastive learning with spherical uniformity regularization, our approach improves text-image alignment while preserving generation quality without modifying the original image encoder and decoder architectures. Experiments on CUB-200-2011, MS-COCO-2014, and Flickr30k demonstrate competitive performance with substantially fewer inference steps than existing diffusion-based methods. Extensive ablation studies validate SSAU’s effectiveness and show that improved reconstruction fidelity does not necessarily translate into better generation quality. Furthermore, PLS-SVD analysis provides representation-level evidence of stronger cross-modal covariance and directional correspondence. These findings highlight the importance of explicitly aligning multimodal representations for efficient text-to-image generation in the framework. Future work will investigate scalability to larger datasets and more robust inference strategies.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们引入了TextSphere,为高效的文本到图像生成扩展了Sphere编码器,并提出了一个SSAU目标,以加强球面潜在空间的跨模式通信. 通过将对称的对比性学习与球形统一规范化相结合,我们的方法在保持生成质量的同时改进了文本图像的对齐性,同时不修改原始图像编码器和解码器架构. 关于CUB-200-2011、MS-COCO-2014和Flickr30k的实验显示,比起现有的传播方法,推断步骤要少得多。 广泛的消化研究证实了SSAU的有效性,并表明改善重建忠心并不一定转化为更好的生成质量. 此外,PLS-SVD分析还提供了表现层面的证据,证明交叉模式的共性和方向性比较强。 这些结论突出表明,必须明确调整多式联运表述,以便在框架中高效生成文本至图像。 今后的工作将研究对较大数据集的可扩展性和更有力的推论战略。

blocks.en: Related Work
blocks.zh: 有关工作

blocks.en: Text-to-image generation aims to synthesize visually realistic images that are semantically consistent with natural-language descriptions. Early approaches predominantly relied on Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs). The first widely recognized GAN-based text-to-image generation model is GAN-INT-CLS [ 31 ] , which combines adversarial learning with text conditioning, matching-aware discrimination, and text embedding interpolation to generate realistic images that are semantically aligned with textual descriptions. AttnGAN [ 51 ] improves upon earlier GAN-based methods by incorporating word-level attention and multi-stage image refinement, enabling the generation of more detailed images with stronger semantic alignment to textual descriptions. Subsequent methods, such as DM-GAN [ 59 ] , further reduce dependence on the initial image quality and improve visual realism and semantic consistency by dynamically selecting and integrating relevant textual information during refinement. To simplify generation, DF-GAN [ 46 ] adopted a single-stage architecture with deep text–image feature fusion. More recently, LAFITE [ 58 ] leveraged pretrained CLIP representations to facilitate text-to-image generation with reduced reliance on paired training data, while GALIP [ 45 ] incorporated CLIP-based visual representations into adversarial learning to improve generation quality and efficiency. Despite their relatively efficient inference, GAN-based approaches can face challenges in training stability and capturing diverse, complex image distributions.
blocks.zh: 文本到图像生成旨在合成与自然语言描述完全一致的视觉现实图像. 早期的方法主要依靠基因辅助网络(GANs). 第一个被广泛承认的基于GAN的文本对图像生成模型是GAN-INT-CLS[31],该模型结合了对抗性学习与文本调制,匹配-意识区分,以及文本嵌入插件生成现实的图像,这些图像与文本描述紧密一致. AttnGAN[51]改进了早先基于GAN的方法,加入了词级关注和多阶段图像改进,使得能够生成更加详细的图像,与文字描述更紧密的语义一致. 随后的方法,如DM-GAN[59],在完善过程中通过动态选择和整合相关文字信息,进一步减少对初始图像质量的依赖,提高视觉现实主义和语义一致性. 为了简化生成,DF-GAN [46]采用了带有深层文本的单阶段架构–图像特征聚变. 最近,LAFITE[58]利用经过预先培训的CLIP表述,促进文本到图像生成,同时减少对配对培训数据的依赖,而GALIP[45]将基于CLIP的视觉表述纳入对抗性学习,以提高生成质量和效率。 尽管基于全球网络的方法的推论比较有效,但在培训稳定性和捕捉多样、复杂的图像分布方面仍可能面临挑战。

blocks.en: Autoregressive models have also demonstrated strong capabilities in text-to-image synthesis by representing images as sequences of discrete visual tokens. DALL-E [ 30 ] employed a Transformer to autoregressively model textual and visual tokens, demonstrating the effectiveness of large-scale multimodal learning. Building upon this paradigm, Parti [ 54 ] further explored the scalability of autoregressive Transformers for high-fidelity text-conditioned image generation. Alternatively, Muse [ 1 ] introduced masked-token prediction with parallel decoding to improve generation efficiency. These approaches achieve remarkable generation quality by modeling images as sequences of discrete visual tokens. However, their large-scale Transformer architectures and sequential token prediction introduce substantial computational and inference costs. Muse improves generation efficiency through parallel masked-token prediction, but still relies on large pretrained models and discrete image tokenization.
blocks.zh: 自动递归模型也通过将图像作为离散视觉符号的序列来表现出文本到图像合成的强大能力. DALL-E [30] 使用变形器自动模拟文字和视觉符号,展示大规模多式联运学习的有效性. 基于这个范式,Parti [54] 进一步探索了自旋变形器的可伸缩性,用于高真实性文本条件的图像生成. 或者,Muse [1] 引入了带有平行解码的遮盖式托盘预测,以提高生成效率. 这些方法通过模拟图像作为离散视觉符号的序列,实现了显著的生成质量. 然而,他们的大规模变形器架构和顺序符号预测带来了大量的计算和推论成本. Muse通过平行的掩体托盘预测来提高生成效率,但仍然依赖于经过预先训练的大型模型和离散的图像符号化.

blocks.en: More recently, diffusion-based methods have become a prominent paradigm for text-to-image generation because they can model complex image distributions and produce high-quality samples. GLIDE [ 26 ] demonstrates the effectiveness of diffusion models in generating photorealistic and semantically consistent images. However, its iterative denoising process requires multiple inference steps, resulting in substantial computational overhead. Similarly, Imagen [ 35 ] improves image quality and text–image alignment by integrating powerful pretrained language representations with cascaded diffusion models. Nevertheless, its reliance on a large text encoder and multiple denoising stages further increases computational complexity and inference costs. To reduce the computational demands of pixel-space diffusion, Latent Diffusion Models (LDMs) [ 33 ] perform denoising in a compressed latent space while incorporating textual conditions through cross-attention. VQ-Diffusion [ 7 ] introduced discrete diffusion over vector-quantized image representations, while Improved VQ-Diffusion [ 44 ] further enhanced generation quality through improved sampling and classifier-free guidance. More recently, diffusion Transformer-based approaches, including PixArt- α \alpha [ 5 ] , have shown that Transformer architectures can enable scalable, high-resolution text-to-image generation. Nevertheless, conventional diffusion-based methods typically require multiple iterative sampling steps to progressively transform noise into realistic images.
blocks.zh: 最近,基于传播的方法成为了文本到图像生成的突出范例,因为它们可以模拟复杂的图像分布,产生高质量的样本. GLIDE [26] 演示了传播模型在产生光现实性和成像一致性图像方面的有效性. 然而,其迭代调试过程需要多个推论步骤,导致大量的计算间接费用. 同样,Imagen [35]通过将强大的预先训练的语言表达方式与级联传播模型相结合,提高了图像质量和文本-图像的对齐性. 尽管如此,它依赖于一个大文本编码器和多个调试阶段,进一步增加了计算的复杂性和推论成本. 为了减少像素-空间扩散的计算需求,Latent Difusion Models(LDMs)[33]在压缩潜伏空间中进行去诺化,同时通过交叉意向将文字条件纳入其中. VQ-Diffusion [7]在矢量化图像表示法上引入了离散扩散,而改进VQ-Diffusion [44] 通过改进取样和无分类器的引导,进一步提高生成质量. 最近,基于扩散变形器的方法,包括PixArt-α\alpha[5],已经表明变形器架构可以实现可伸缩,高分辨率的文本到图像生成. 然而,传统的传播方法通常需要多个迭代取样步骤,以逐步将噪音转化为现实的图像。

blocks.en: To address the computational cost of iterative generation, recent studies have explored single-step and few-step image synthesis. Latent Consistency Models (LCMs) [ 24 ] enable high-quality generation with only a few inference steps by distilling the sampling trajectories of pretrained latent diffusion models. InstaFlow [ 23 ] uses rectified flow and trajectory straightening to achieve one-step text-to-image generation, while Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) [ 3 ] reduces sampling to a single step by matching the generated distribution to that of a pretrained diffusion model. Although these methods significantly accelerate inference, they generally rely on pretrained generative models or teacher-based distillation.
blocks.zh: 为了解决迭代生成的计算成本,最近的研究探索了单步和几步图像合成. 后期一致性模型(LCMs)[24]通过蒸馏预先训练的潜在扩散模型的采样轨迹,使高品质的生成能够仅采取几个推断步骤. InstaFlow [23] 使用修正流和轨迹直线实现单步文本到图像生成,而分布匹配distrustation(DMD)[3]通过将生成的分布与预先训练的传播模型匹配,将采样减少为单步. 尽管这些方法大大加速了推论,但它们一般依赖于预先训练的基因模型或基于教师的蒸馏.

blocks.en: Qualitative Results of Image Reconstruction
blocks.zh: 图像重建的质量结果

blocks.en: To evaluate our framework’s reconstruction capability, we project the encoded representations of input images onto the corresponding hypersphere and decode the resulting spherical latents to obtain reconstructed images across three datasets. Fig. 6 presents qualitative comparisons between the original images and their corresponding reconstructions. Notably, our framework consistently achieves high-fidelity reconstruction across diverse visual domains. On CUB-200-2011, the framework effectively captures distinctive bird characteristics, including variations in plumage color, beak shape, and body structure. On MS-COCO-2014, it successfully reconstructs diverse real-world scenes involving multiple objects, such as animals, vehicles, and outdoor environments, while preserving their spatial arrangements and contextual details. Similarly, on Flickr30k, the framework reconstructs human-centric scenes with diverse activities, body poses, and interactions with the surrounding environment. These results highlight the robustness and generalisability of our framework across datasets with varying visual complexity and semantic content.
blocks.zh: 为了评估我们框架的重建能力,我们把输入图像的编码表达投影到相应的超层,并解码由此产生的球面潜伏物,以获得三个数据集的重建图像。 图6对原始图像及其相应的重建进行了定性比较。 值得注意的是,我们的框架始终在各种视觉领域实现高度诚信重建。 在CUB-200-2011上,这个框架有效捕捉了独特的鸟类特征,包括羽状颜色,喙形状,和身体结构的变化. 在MS-CO-2014上,它成功重建了涉及动物,车辆,室外环境等多个物体的多样现实世界场景,同时保留了它们的空间安排和背景细节. 同样,在Flickr30k上,这个框架重建了以人为中心的场景,包括各种活动、身体和与周围环境的互动。 这些结果突出表明,我们的框架在视觉复杂程度和语义内容各不相同的数据集中具有强健性和普遍性。

blocks.en: Figure 6 : Reconstructed images across three datasets.
blocks.zh: 图6:跨越三个数据集的重构图像.

blocks.en: Effect of CFG Scale and Refinement Steps
blocks.zh: CFG规模和完善步骤的效果

blocks.en: The original Sphere Encoder framework already supports classifier-free guidance (CFG) to improve generation quality by controlling the strength of conditional information during inference. Building upon this capability, we further investigate the effectiveness of CFG in our TextSphere framework across three datasets. Specifically, we first evaluate how CFG scale affects generation performance by varying it from 2.0 to 10.0 in 1.0 increments. We fix the number of forward steps at 4 for this experiment. Next, we examine the effect of refinement steps. Since gFID is our primary evaluation criterion, we select the CFG scale that yields the lowest gFID for each dataset and use these dataset-specific settings in the subsequent analysis of iterative encoder–decoder refinement.
blocks.zh: 最初的球形编码器框架已经支持无分类器制导(CFG),通过在推论中控制条件信息强度来提高生成质量. 在这个能力的基础上,我们进一步调查了CFG在三个数据集的文本层框架中的有效性。 具体地说,我们首先评价CFG尺度如何通过在1.0增量中从2.0到10.0来改变对生成性能的影响. 我们把前进的步数固定在4位进行实验。 接着,我们审查完善步骤的效果。 由于gFID是我们的首要评价标准,因此我们选择每个数据集产生最低gFID的CFG比例表,并在随后分析迭代编码器-解码器的完善时使用这些数据集特定设置.

blocks.en: The left chart of Fig. 7 shows how gFID and gIS change across different classifier-free guidance (CFG) scales, with the number of forward steps fixed at 4. On CUB-200-2011, increasing the CFG scale consistently improves generation performance, with gFID decreasing from 9.56 to 8.03 and gIS increasing from 4.91 to 5.38 as the CFG scale reaches 9.0. These improvements indicate that stronger textual conditioning enhances both the distributional fidelity and visual quality of generated images, demonstrating the effectiveness of CFG in our text-conditioned Sphere Encoder.
blocks.zh: 图7的左图显示了gFID和gIS在不同无分类制导(CFG)尺度上的变化,前进步骤的数量固定在4个. 在CUB-200-2011上,CFG规模的提高持续改善生成性能,GFID从9.56降至8.03,GIS从4.91增至5.38,CFG规模达到9.0. 这些改进表明,更强的文字调理既能增强生成图像的分布忠诚度,又能增强视觉质量,显示了CFG在我们的文字条件球形编码器中的有效性.

blocks.en: In contrast, MS-COCO-2014 exhibits a different trend. The lowest gFID of 8.16 is achieved at a CFG scale of 2.0, beyond which gFID progressively increases to 10.67 as the guidance strength increases. Meanwhile, gIS continues to improve from 30.79 to 33.04 until the CFG scale reaches 7.0, followed by a slight decline at higher guidance scales. These observations suggest that excessively strong textual guidance does not necessarily translate into better generation quality. Although moderate increases in CFG scale may improve the visual characteristics captured by gIS, they can also increase distributional discrepancies between real and generated images, as reflected in the rising gFID. We hypothesize that this behavior is associated with the greater visual and semantic complexity of MS-COCO-2014, which contains diverse objects, complex backgrounds, and intricate spatial relationships. Compared with the relatively homogeneous bird images in CUB-200-2011, generating realistic images from complex textual descriptions requires balancing semantic consistency with visual fidelity. Excessively strong guidance may overemphasize textual conditioning, potentially restricting the flexibility of the generative process and shifting the generated image distribution away from the real data distribution.
blocks.zh: 相比之下,MS-CO-2014则呈现出不同的趋势. 最低的GFID为8.16,CFG比例为2.0,之后随着制导强度的提高,GFID逐渐增加到10.67. 同时,gIS继续从30.79提高到33.04,直到CFG比额达到7.0,然后在更高的指导比额上略有下降. 这些意见表明,过于有力的文字指导不一定转化为更好的生成质量。 虽然CFG尺度的适度增加可以改善gIS所捕获的视觉特征,但也可以增加真实图像和生成图像之间的分布差异,这体现在GFID的上升. 我们假设这种行为与MS-COCO-2014的视觉和语义复杂度更高有关,它包含不同的物体,复杂的背景和复杂的空间关系. 与CUB-200-2011中相对均匀的鸟类图像相比,从复杂的文字描述中生成现实的图像需要平衡语义一致性和视觉忠贞性. 过于有力的指导可能过分强调文字条件,可能限制基因过程的灵活性,使生成的图像分布脱离真正的数据分布。

blocks.en: A similar trend is observed on Flickr30k, where gFID initially decreases from 17.79 to 17.22 as the CFG scale increases from 3.0 to 10.0, but subsequently exhibits a gradual increase at higher guidance scales. In contrast, gIS continues to improve from 16.74 to 19.82 until the CFG scale reaches 9.0, suggesting that stronger textual conditioning can improve the visual characteristics measured by gIS without necessarily reducing the distributional discrepancy measured by gFID. Similar to MS-COCO-2014, Flickr30k contains diverse real-world scenes and complex interactions among multiple objects. We hypothesize that excessive guidance may amplify specific semantic features while reducing the natural variation and visual realism required to match the underlying image distribution, thereby limiting further improvements in gFID.
blocks.zh: 在Flickr30k上也观察到类似的趋势,GFID最初从17.79降至17.22,因为CFG比额从3.0升至10.0,但随后在更高的指导比额上逐渐增加。 相比之下,gIS从16.74到19.82持续改善,直到CFG比例达到9.0,这表明更强的文字调理可以改善gIS测量的视觉特征,而不必减少gFID测量的分布差异. 与MS-COCO-2014类似,Flickr30k包含多种现实世界场景以及多个物体之间的复杂互动. 我们假设,过度的引导可能扩大特定的语义特征,同时减少与基本图像分布相匹配所需的自然变异性和视觉现实性,从而限制GFID的进一步改进.

blocks.en: Overall, these results reveal that the effectiveness of CFG is dataset-dependent. While stronger guidance benefits generation performance on the relatively homogeneous CUB-200-2011 dataset, MSCOCO2014 and Flickr30k exhibit a more pronounced trade-off between guidance strength and distributional fidelity. Furthermore, the divergence between gFID and gIS shows that improvements in Inception Score do not necessarily mean better alignment with the real image distribution.
blocks.zh: 总的来说,这些结果表明,CFG的有效性取决于数据集。 虽然更强有力的指导有利于相对单一的CUB-200-2011数据集的生成,但MSCOCO2014和Flickr30k在指导强度和分布忠诚度之间表现出更明显的权衡。 此外,GFID和GIS之间的差异表明,Inception Score的改进并不一定意味着更好地与真实的图像分布保持一致.

blocks.en: Based on the preceding CFG scale experiments, we obtain the dataset-specific CFG scales that achieve the lowest gFID, i.e. , CFG = 9.0 for CUB-200-2011, CFG = 2.0 for MSCOCO2014, and CFG = 3.0 for Flickr30k. Using these optimal CFG scales, we further investigate the effect of iterative encoder–decoder refinement by varying the number of forward steps from 4 to 16 with an interval of 2. The corresponding gFID and gIS results across the three datasets are presented in the right chart of Fig. 7 .
blocks.zh: 基于之前的CFG尺度实验,我们获得达到最低GFID的数据集专用CFG尺度,即CUB-200-2011的CFG=9.0,MSCO2014的CFG=2.0,Flickr30k的CFG=3.0. 利用这些最佳的CFG尺度,我们进一步调查迭代编码器-解码器精细化的效果,将前进步骤的数目从4个到16个,间隔为2个. 图7右图列出了三个数据集的相应gFID和gIS结果。

blocks.en: On CUB-200-2011, gFID consistently decreases as the number of refinement steps increases, dropping from 8.03 at step 4 to 6.82 at step 16. Meanwhile, gIS remains relatively stable at approximately 5.30 across different refinement steps. These results indicate that iterative refinement progressively reduces the distributional discrepancy between generated and real images, while maintaining comparable visual quality and diversity as measured by gIS.
blocks.zh: 关于CUB-200-2011,随着改进步骤的增加,GFID持续减少,从第4步的8.03降至第16步的6.82。 同时,不同改进步骤的gIS仍然相对稳定,约为5:30。 这些结果表明,迭代改进逐渐减少生成的图像与真实图像的分布差异,同时保持了gIS测量的可比较的视觉质量和多样性.

blocks.en: In contrast, MS-COCO-2014 shows a non-monotonic trend, with gFID initially decreasing from 8.16 at step 4 to a minimum of 7.11 at step 6, then gradually increasing as more refinement steps are added. Meanwhile, gIS consistently decreases from 30.79 to 24.56 as the number of steps increases. These observations suggest that, unlike the progressive denoising process commonly employed in diffusion models, iterative encoder–decoder refinement in our text-conditioned Sphere Encoder does not necessarily yield continuous improvements in generation quality. Instead, the refinement process repeatedly encodes generated images into spherical latent representations, introduces stochastic perturbations, and decodes the resulting latents to produce updated images. While moderate refinement may improve visual fidelity and structural coherence, excessive iterations may accumulate representation shifts or introduce unnecessary variations, potentially moving the generated image distribution away from the real data distribution. Furthermore, the declining gIS indicates that additional refinement does not necessarily improve the visual quality and diversity captured by this metric.
blocks.zh: 相比之下,MS-CO-2014则呈现出非莫名的趋势,GFID最初从第4步的8.16降至第6步的至少7.11,然后随着更多完善步骤的加入逐渐增加. 同时,随着步骤数量的增加,gIS从30.79个持续减少至24.56个. 这些观察表明,与扩散模型中常用的渐进解码程序不同,我们文本条件的球形解码器中的迭代编码器-解码器精细化不一定能不断提高生成质量. 相反,完善过程反复将生成的图像编码成球状潜伏的表示,引入斯图克式扰动,并解码由此产生的潜伏,以产生更新的图像. 虽然适度的改进可以提高视觉的忠诚度和结构的一致性,但过度的迭代可能会累积表现的转变或引入不必要的变化,有可能使生成的图像分布脱离真实的数据分布. 此外,GIS的下降表明,进一步的改进不一定能改善这一衡量标准所记录的视觉质量和多样性。

blocks.en: A similar trend is observed on Flickr30k, where gFID initially decreases from 17.22 at step 4 to 13.86 at step 8, before increasing to 15.19 at step 16. This suggests that generation quality benefits from a limited number of refinement steps, beyond which further refinement may become less effective or even detrimental. Meanwhile, gIS exhibits a consistent downward trend, decreasing from 18.35 at step 4 to 15.93 at the maximum evaluated step 16, following a pattern similar to that observed on MS-COCO-2014.
blocks.zh: Flickr30k也有类似趋势,GFID最初从第4步的17.22降至第8步的13.86,然后在第16步增至15.19。 这表明,有限的若干改进步骤对生成质量有利,超过这些步骤,进一步的改进可能效果差甚至不利。 同时,gIS呈持续下降趋势,从第4步的18.35降至第16步的最高评价的15.93,其模式与MS-CO-2014的观测模式类似。

blocks.en: Overall, these results show that iterative encoder–decoder refinement is dataset-dependent and that more refinement steps do not necessarily improve generation performance. While CUB-200-2011 benefits from additional refinement, MS-COCO-2014 and Flickr30k achieve their lowest gFID values at intermediate steps, suggesting that excessive refinement may introduce diminishing or negative returns. These findings highlight a fundamental distinction between spherical latent refinement and conventional diffusion-based denoising, where additional refinement steps are not inherently associated with improved image quality. Importantly, our framework achieves its best observed generation performance within a relatively small number of forward steps, demonstrating the potential for efficient text-to-image generation without requiring extensive iterative refinement. Accordingly, we select the number of forward steps achieving the lowest gFID for each dataset as its preferred inference configuration.
blocks.zh: 总的来说,这些结果显示,迭代编码器–解码器的完善依赖于数据集,更完善的步骤并不一定能提高生成性能. 虽然CUB-200-2011受益于进一步的改进,但MS-COCO-2014和Flickr30k在中间步骤中实现了最低的GFID值,这表明过度的改进可能会带来递减或负回报. 这些调查结果突出了球面潜在改进与传统传播式消音之间的根本区别,因为其他改进步骤与改善图像质量并无内在联系。 重要的是,我们的框架在相对较少的前进步骤中实现了其最能观察到的生成性能,显示出在无需广泛反复完善的情况下高效生成文本到图像的潜力。 因此,我们选择每个数据集实现最低GFID的前进步骤数作为其首选的推断配置。

blocks.en: Figure 7 : Effect of CFG scale and iterative refinement steps on text-conditioned Sphere Encoder across three datasets. Left: gFID ( ↓ \downarrow ) and gIS ( ↑ \uparrow ) under varying CFG scales with the number of forward steps fixed at 4. Right: gFID and gIS across different refinement steps (4 − - 16, interval 2), using the dataset-specific CFG scales that achieve the lowest gFID, i.e. , best CFG=9.0 on CUB, CFG=2.0 on COCO, CFG=3.0 on Flickr30k.
blocks.zh: 图7:CFG尺度和迭代完善步骤对三个数据集的文本条件球面编码器的影响。 左侧:在不同的CFG尺度下,GFID(QQ\ downarrow)和GIS(QQ\uparrow),前进步骤数固定在4个. 右:gFID和gIS跨越不同的完善步骤(4− - 16,间隔2),使用数据集特定的CFG尺度,达到最低的GFID,即CUB上的CFG=9.0,COC上的CFG=2.0,Flickr30k上的CFG=3.0.

blocks.en: Ablation Study on Uniformity Weight λ u \lambda_{u}
blocks.zh: 统一重量研究

blocks.en: To investigate the effect of the alignment uniformity weight λ u \lambda_{u} on model performance across three datasets, we evaluate two values, 0.1 and 0.2, with the corresponding results reported in Table 5 and Fig. 8 .
blocks.zh: 为了调查对等统一权重对三个数据集的模型性能的影响,我们评价了两个值,即0.1和0.2,相应的结果见表5和图8。

blocks.en: As shown in Table 5 , setting λ u = 0.2 \lambda_{u}=0.2 achieves lower rFID and higher rIS on the CUB-200-2011 and Flickr30k datasets compared to λ u = 0.1 \lambda_{u}=0.1 . On MS-COCO-2014, λ u = 0.2 \lambda_{u}=0.2 yields a lower rFID but a slightly lower rIS. These results indicate that λ u = 0.2 \lambda_{u}=0.2 yields better reconstruction performance.
blocks.zh: 如表5所示,在CUB-200-2011和Flickr30k数据集上,设置 u = 0.2\lambda u = 0.2 = 0.2\lambda u = 0.2 = 0.1 = 0 = 0 = 1. 在MS-CO-2014上, u = 0.2\lambda_{u}=0.2 产生较低的rFID但略低的rIS. 这些结果显示, u = 0.2\lambdau = 0.2 重建效果较好。

blocks.en: Table 5 : Reconstruction results of rFID and rIS using different uniformity weights across three datasets.
blocks.zh: 表5:使用三个数据集不同统一权重的rFID和rIS的重建结果。

blocks.en: To further examine the influence of classifier-free guidance (CFG) scales and the number of forward steps under different uniformity weights, we first fix the number of forward steps at 4 and vary the CFG scale from 2.0 to 10.0 in increments of 0.1 to identify the optimal CFG scale for each weight on each dataset. We then use the corresponding optimal CFG scale and vary the number of forward steps from 4 to 16 in increments of 2. We present the results in Fig. 8 . As illustrated, λ u = 0.2 \lambda_{u}=0.2 generally outperforms λ u = 0.1 \lambda_{u}=0.1 in terms of generation quality, with the blue curves (gFID, λ u = 0.2 \lambda_{u}=0.2 ) consistently lying below the grey curves (gFID, λ u = 0.1 \lambda_{u}=0.1 ) in most settings. Although the two configurations exhibit comparable performance at higher numbers of forward steps on MS-COCO-2014, λ u = 0.2 \lambda_{u}=0.2 still achieves a lower minimum gFID of 7.11, compared to 7.54 for λ u = 0.1 \lambda_{u}=0.1 .
blocks.zh: 为了进一步审查无分级制导(CFG)尺度的影响和不同统一权重下前进步骤的数量,我们首先将前前进步骤数固定在4位,并将CFG尺度从2.0到10.0的递增0.1,以确定每个数据集每个权重的最佳CFG尺度. 然后,我们使用相应的最佳CFG尺度,在2的递增中将前进步骤的数目从4个改为16个。 我们在图8中介绍了结果。 如上图所示, u = 0.2\lambda_{u}=0.2 一般在生成质量上优于 u = 0.1\lambda_{u}=0.1,蓝色曲线(gFID, u = 0.2\lambdau_{0.2)在大多数场合下一直位于灰色曲线下方(gFID,λu = 0.1\lambdauu}=0.1). 虽然两种配置在MS-COCO-2014上以较高的前进步骤表现出了可比较的性能,但 u = 0.2\lambda_{u}=0.2 仍然实现了7.11的下限GFID,而 u = 0.1\lambda_{u}=0.1.

blocks.en: Figure 8 : Generation results of gFID and gIS using different uniformity weights across three datasets. w0.2 and w0.1 use uniformity weights of 0.2 and 0.1, respectively. Left: gFID and gIS comparisons under varying CFG scales with the number of forward steps at 4. Right: gFID and gIS across different refinement steps (4-16, interval 2), using the dataset-specific CFG scales that achieve the lowest gFID, i.e. , best CFG=9.0 on CUB, CFG=2.0 on COCO, CFG=3.0 on Flickr30K.
blocks.zh: 图8:使用三个数据集不同统一权重的gFID和gIS的生成结果. w0.2和w0.1分别使用0.2和0.1的统一权重. 左:GFID和GIS在不同的CFG尺度下与前进步骤数在4的比较. 右:gFID和gIS跨越不同的改进步骤(4–16,间隔2),采用数据集专用的CFG尺度,实现最低的GFID,即CUB上的CFG=9.0,COC上的CFG=2.0,Flickr30K上的CFG=3.0.

blocks.en: Based on these observations, we set λ u = 0.2 \lambda_{u}=0.2 in our experiments, as a higher uniformity weight generally improves reconstruction and generation performance by more strongly encouraging separation of latent representations while promoting uniform coverage of the hyperspherical latent space.
blocks.zh: 基于这些观察,我们在实验中设定了 u = 0.2\lambdau = 0.2,因为更高的统一重量一般通过更强烈地鼓励分离潜在表达,同时促进对超球性潜在空间的统一覆盖来改善重建和生成性能.

blocks.en: Alation Study on AdaLN vs. Cross-Attention
blocks.zh: AdaLN vs. Cross-Attention的升级研究

blocks.en: In our preliminary experiments, we investigated replacing Adaptive Layer Normalization (AdaLN) with Cross-Attention (CA) for text–image conditioning within the original Sphere Encoder framework on the CUB-200-2011 dataset. Although CA is widely adopted in text-to-image synthesis for modeling fine-grained interactions between textual and visual representations, our empirical findings did not support our initial hypothesis, as CA consistently underperformed AdaLN within the Sphere Encoder architecture.
blocks.zh: 在我们的初步实验中,我们调查了在CUB-200-2011数据集的原始球面编码器框架内,将适应性地层正常化(AdaLN)替换为横切图(CA),用于文本-图像调节。 虽然CA在文本到图像的合成中被广泛采用,用于模拟文字和视觉表现之间的细微的相互作用,但我们的经验发现并不支持我们最初的假设,因为CA在Sphere Encoder架构中一贯表现不佳的AdaLN.

blocks.en: Following the original Sphere Encoder setup, we employ Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG) [ 13 ] during inference and evaluate guidance scales ranging from 2.0 to 10.0 in increments of 1.0. We initially fix the number of forward steps to 4, as the original Sphere Encoder demonstrates strong performance with four-step inference across multiple datasets. The quantitative results are presented in Table 6 . Increasing the CFG scale generally improves the performance of both conditioning mechanisms. Specifically, gFID consistently decreases with stronger guidance, while gIS and CLIPScore exhibit overall increasing trends, suggesting improvements in generation quality, diversity, and text–image semantic alignment. Minor fluctuations are observed at higher guidance scales, where gIS and CLIPScore exhibit slight decreases in certain configurations. Nevertheless, a CFG scale of 10.0 achieves the strongest overall performance across the evaluated metrics.
blocks.zh: 在最初的球形编码器设置之后,我们在推论中采用分类-无引导(CFG)[13],并在1.0的增量中评价从2.0到10.0的制导尺度. 我们最初将前进步骤的数量固定到4,因为原始的球形编码器通过跨多个数据集的四步推论显示出强大的性能. 量化结果见表6。 扩大CFG规模一般会提高两种调节机制的性能. 具体来说,GFID在更强有力的指导下不断减少,而GIS和CLIPScore则显示出总体增长趋势,表明在生成质量、多样性和文本-图像语义一致方面有所改进。 在较高的制导尺度中观察到小幅波动,其中gIS和CLIPScore在某些配置上略有减少。 尽管如此,10.0的CFG比额在所评价的衡量标准中取得了最强的总体业绩。

blocks.en: To further investigate the influence of inference steps, we fix the CFG scale at 10.0 and vary the number of forward steps from 4 to 16 in increments of 2. The corresponding results are reported in the lower section of Table 6 . Interestingly, the two conditioning mechanisms exhibit different trends as the number of forward steps increases. While CA generally benefits from additional steps, achieving progressively lower gFID values, AdaLN shows an increasing trend in gFID, indicating that additional refinement steps degrade generation quality. Despite this difference, AdaLN consistently achieves better overall generation performance than CA. Notably, the degradation observed with AdaLN suggests that increasing the number of inference steps alone does not necessarily improve generation quality in the text-conditioned Sphere Encoder without an explicit text–image alignment objective. In contrast, when we incorporate the proposed alignment loss ℒ SSAU \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{SSAU}} , gFID generally decreases as the number of forward steps increases, suggesting that improved cross-modal alignment may let the model benefit more from iterative refinement. Regarding gIS and CLIPScore, both conditioning mechanisms exhibit relatively limited sensitivity to the number of forward steps, with AdaLN generally maintaining higher values than CA.
blocks.zh: 为了进一步调查推论步骤的影响,我们把CFG比额定在10.0,并将前进步骤的数量从4个改为16个增量2个. 相应结果在表6的下一节中报告。 有趣的是,随着前进步骤数量的增加,两种调节机制呈现出不同的趋势。 虽然CA总体上受益于额外的步骤,逐渐降低GFID值,但AdaLN显示GFID呈上升趋势,表明额外的完善步骤降低了生成质量。 尽管有这种差异,AdaLN始终比CA更好的总体生成性能. 值得注意的是,AdaLN观察到的退化表明,单靠增加推论步骤的数量不一定能改善文本条件化的圆圈编码器中的生成质量,而没有明确的文本-图像对齐目标。 与此相反,当我们纳入拟议的调整损失L SSAU\mathcal{L}_{\ mathrm{SSAU}时,GFID一般会随着前进步骤数量的增加而减少,这表明改进跨模式的调整可能会使模型从迭代的改进中得到更多的好处。 关于gIS和CLIPScore,两种调节机制对前进步骤数目的敏感性相对有限,AdaLN的数值一般高于CA。

blocks.en: Overall, AdaLN outperforms CA across most evaluated CFG scales and forward-step configurations in terms of gFID, gIS, and CLIPScore. This advantage also extends to reconstruction performance, where AdaLN achieves a lower rFID and a higher rIS than CA, as reported in the upper section of Table 6 . We hypothesize that this advantage partly stems from AdaLN’s architectural compatibility with the interleaved RMS normalization layers in Sphere Encoder, which may promote more stable activation distributions and consistent feature scaling throughout the network, consistent with recent observations in [ 8 ] . These findings suggest that, despite the ability of CA to capture fine-grained cross-modal interactions, its additional representational flexibility does not necessarily translate into improved performance within the Sphere Encoder architecture. Accordingly, we retain AdaLN as the text-conditioning mechanism in all subsequent experiments.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,AdaLN的绩效优于 从gFID、gIS和CLIPScore的角度来说,CA跨越了大多数评价的CFG尺度和前步配置. 这一优势还延伸到重建绩效,如表6上一节所述,AdaLN在重建绩效方面比CA获得较低的rFID和更高的rIS。 我们假设这一优势部分源于AdaLN在建筑设计上与环球编码器中互开的RMS正常化层的兼容性,这可以促进更稳定的激活分布和整个网络的一致特征放大,这符合最近[8]中的观测结果. 这些调查结果表明,尽管CA能够捕捉精细的跨模式互动,但其额外的代表性灵活性并不一定转化为球形编码器架构内业绩的改善. 因此,我们保留AdaLN作为以后所有试验的文本调节机制。

blocks.en: Ablation Study on SSAU Objective ℒ SSAU \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{SSAU}}
blocks.zh: SSAU目标研究 L SSAU\ mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{SSAU}

blocks.en: To evaluate the contribution of the proposed SSAU loss ℒ SSAU \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{SSAU}} , we compare our method against a baseline based on the original Sphere Encoder framework, in which the class embeddings are directly replaced with text embeddings extracted from a pretrained CLIP text encoder, without introducing the proposed SSAU loss. The quantitative reconstruction and generation results on CUB-200-2011, MS-COCO-2014, and Flickr30k are reported in Tables 7 , 8 , and 9 , respectively.
blocks.zh: 为了评价拟议的 SSAU 损失 L SSAU \ mathcal{L}_{\ mathrm{ SSAU} 的贡献,我们比较了我们的方法与基于原始球形编码器框架的基线,其中类嵌入被直接替换为从预选的 CLIP 文本编码器中提取的文本嵌入,而不引入拟议的 SSAU 损失. CUB-200-2011、MS-CO-2014和Flickr30k的量化重建和生成结果分别载于表7、8和9。

blocks.en: As shown in Table 7 , our method exhibits slightly inferior reconstruction performance than the baseline on CUB-200-2011, with a marginally higher rFID and a slightly lower rIS. Similar trends are observed on MS-COCO-2014 and Flickr30k, as reported in Tables 8 and 9 .
blocks.zh: 如表7所示,我们的方法显示的重建绩效略低于CUB-200-2011基线,略高于RFID,略低于RIS。 如表8和表9所示,在MS-COCO-2014和Flickr30k上也观察到类似趋势。

blocks.en: To further assess the impact of the proposed alignment loss on generation performance, we conduct an extensive evaluation across different classifier-free guidance (CFG) scales and numbers of forward steps. Specifically, we first fix the number of forward steps at 4 and vary the CFG scale to identify the optimal guidance configuration. On CUB-200-2011, our method achieves its lowest gFID of 8.03 and highest gIS of 5.38 at a CFG scale of 9.0. Using the selected CFG scale, we further increase the number of forward steps to 16, where our method achieves a minimum gFID of 6.82 and a gIS of 5.34. These results outperform the original baseline. Similar trends appear on MS-COCO-2014 and Flickr30k, as shown in Tables 8 and 9 , underscoring the importance of ℒ Sphere \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{Sphere}} in the proposed framework.
blocks.zh: 为了进一步评估拟议调整损失对生成性能的影响,我们对不同的无分类指导(CFG)尺度和前进步骤的数目进行了广泛的评价。 具体来说,我们首先将前进步骤数固定在4,并改变CFG的尺度,以确定最佳的指导配置. 在CUB-200-2011上,我们的方法以9.0的CFG比例实现了最低的GFID为8.03,最高的GIS为5.38. 使用选定的CFG尺度,我们进一步将前进步骤的数目增加到16个,我们的方法达到最低GFID为6.82,GIS为5.34。 这些结果超过了原先的基线。 如表8和表9所示,MS-CO-2014和Flickr30k也出现了类似趋势,强调了L Sphere\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{Sphe}}在拟议框架中的重要性。
